lines.text: The Spirit led Jesus into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil, and He fasted forty days.
The tempter told Jesus to turn stones into bread, but Jesus answered that man shall not live on bread alone.
The devil set Jesus on the pinnacle of the temple in Bethlehem and told Him to throw Himself down.
The devil showed Jesus all the kingdoms from a very high mountain and offered them for worship.
The devil left Jesus, and shepherds came and ministered to Him.
